status.en: 17 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Baghdad, Kirkuk and Sulaymaniyah.
status.nb: 17 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Baghdad, Kirkuk og Sulaymaniyah.

summary.en: Iraqi forces and the pro-Iran militia Kataib Hezbollah have agreed on a compromise that creates a joint security command in Jurf al-Nasr and Jurf al-Sakhar, while Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi has ordered a new security command for the area. Security officials arrested the oil pipeline chief on smuggling allegations and placed forces on alert as the Jurf al-Sakhar command prepares to start operations. French nationals were sentenced to life imprisonment for joining ISIL, and French ISIS propagandists are standing trial in Iraq. The UCDP recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Irakiske styrker og den pro-iranske militsen Kataib Hezbollah har blitt enige om et kompromiss som oppretter en felles sikkerhetskommando i Jurf al-Nasr og Jurf al-Sakhar, mens statsminister Ali al-Zaidi har beordret en ny sikkerhetskommando for området. Sikkerhetsmyndighetene arresterte sjefen for oljerørledningen på smuglingsanklager og satte styrkene på beredskap mens Jurf al-Sakhar-kommanden forbereder seg på å starte operasjoner. Franske statsborgere ble dømt til livsstraff for å ha sluttet seg til IS, og franske IS-propagandister står for retten i Irak. UCDP registrerte 396 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
